questions.question: How does Proverbs 28 describe the wicked and the righteous regarding fear?
options: Both the wicked and the righteous alike flee away in great fear together
The wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are bold as a lion
Both the wicked and the righteous alike are completely fearless before all
Both the wicked and the righteous alike stand their ground bold and unmoved
questions.answer: The wicked flee when no one pursues, but the righteous are bold as a lion

questions.question: What happens to one who conceals his transgressions, per Proverbs 28?
options: He will be quietly pardoned in the end once enough time has finally passed
He will not prosper, but whoever confesses and forsakes them obtains mercy
He will be greatly honored by all the people for guarding his own good name
He will grow exceedingly rich and so escape every single kind of harm
questions.answer: He will not prosper, but whoever confesses and forsakes them obtains mercy
